# FabricOps Starter Kit

> FabricOps Starter Kit helps teams build governed, quality-checked, Microsoft Fabric notebook workflows with reusable helpers, notebook templates, metadata-backed contracts, data quality checks, lineage, and handover evidence.

Use this file as a concise navigation map for documentation and automation workflows. The human-readable documentation is also published with Markdown variants where possible; for example, `/guided-demo/` is available as `/guided-demo.md`.

## Get Started

- [Guided Demo](guided-demo.md): First path through the starter workflow and key concepts.
- [Install](install.md): Package installation, Fabric runtime setup notes, and first-run verification checks.
- [Create Wheel](guided-demo/create-wheel.md): Build a wheel for Microsoft Fabric upload.

## Architecture

- [How FabricOps Works](how-fabricops-works.md): Overview of the governed Fabric notebook operating model.
- [List of Metadata Tables](reference/metadata-tables/index.md): Metadata table responsibilities and governance evidence model.
- [Pipeline Guardrails](how-fabricops-works/guardrails/pipeline-guardrails.md): Runtime guardrails for schemas, freshness, DQ enforcement, and profile behavior.
- [Metadata Dashboard](how-fabricops-works/notebook-templates/metadata-dashboard.md): Operational visibility over metadata and governance outputs.

## Notebook flow

- [Notebook Templates](how-fabricops-works/notebook-templates/index.md): Responsibilities of `00_env_config`, agreement, pipeline, governance, and exploration notebooks.

## Metadata and contracts

- [Data Quality and Governance](how-fabricops-works/notebook-templates/governance-review.md): Review flows for column context, classification, DQ rules, and governance evidence.
- [DQ Rules Reference](reference/dq-rules.md): Supported rule types, parameters, examples, and enforcement expectations.
- [Glossary](reference/glossary.md): Shared terminology for governed notebook delivery.

## API reference

- [Function Reference](reference.md): Public callable reference generated from source docstrings and metadata.
- [Functions by Module](api/modules.md): Module-oriented callable index for package users and maintainers.
- [Automation Manifest](reference/_data/automation-manifest.json): Machine-readable helper metadata for automation tools.
- [Function Manifest](reference/_data/function-manifest.json): Machine-readable function inventory and dependency metadata.

## Handover and maintenance

- [Release Management](development/release-management.md): Maintainer workflow for releases, versioning, and generated references.
- [Documentation Versioning](development/docs-versioning.md): Documentation versioning and traceability guidance.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution workflow and expectations.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md): Repository-level overview and navigation.

## Markdown navigation

- This static navigation file and Markdown page variants support deterministic documentation ingestion.
